build_variational_module: build a Variational Haiku module with shared dense layers and mean and log variance output heads
create_variational_distribution: create a Normal distribution q(H|O) by calling the Variational module with input arrays
review_variational_init: review the Variational class __init__ to understand layer size and activation configuration
summarize_variational_call: summarize the Variational __call__ method which concatenates inputs and produces a TFP Normal distribution
test_variational_inference: test the Variational module by passing JAX arrays and verifying the returned TFP distribution
